Select de-immunized bovine adenosine deaminase (ADA / P56658) candidates that are also catalytically plausible, by running the full holo tier stack T0-T3 on the 0-NMP refinement shortlist. ADA is the MAXIMAL instantiation of the holo protocol: a required metal cofactor (Zn2+), a transition-state analogue (PRH) reporting the closed pocket, and a physiological substrate (adenosine) - three ligand states, each gating a different tier.

Select de-immunized arginine deiminase (ADI / P23793) candidates that retain substrate recognition, by running the holo protocol's REDUCED form on the 0-NMP refinement shortlist. ADI is the ORDINARY instantiation: no metal cofactor and no transition-state analogue, so only T0 plus a single-ligand substrate check applies - T1 and T2 are structurally absent, not skipped. The discriminating metric is a group-aware interaction fingerprint, not a pose RMSD.
